# Airport Split Transfer

> Private, fixed-price airport transfers and taxi service from Split Airport (SPU) to destinations across the Dalmatian coast, Croatia. Licensed drivers, English-speaking, 24/7 availability.

Airport Split Transfer (legal name: De Niro, obrt za prijevoz) provides private vehicle transfers between Split Airport and destinations across the Split-Dalmatia and Šibenik-Knin coast, including Split, Kaštela, Trogir, Podstrana, Omiš, the Makarska Riviera (Makarska, Brela, Baška Voda, Promajna, Tučepi, Živogošće and smaller villages), Šibenik, Vodice, Primošten, Rogoznica, Zadar, Plitvice Lakes National Park, and Dubrovnik. The full, current list of routes — in both directions (Split Airport to town, and town to Split Airport) — is at /destinations, with a search filter; new routes are added regularly, so this file does not enumerate them all.

Vehicles: Sedan (up to 4 passengers), Business Van / Mercedes V-Class (up to 7 passengers), Van (up to 8 passengers). The price is a fixed rate per vehicle class, not per passenger, and is computed instantly from the exact pickup and drop-off address entered in the online booking form — there is no flat per-destination list price, since the exact fare depends on the specific address within each town. A return (round-trip) booking automatically includes a 5% discount on the total price. Tolls, fuel and meet-and-greet at arrivals are always included; flight numbers are tracked so pickup times adjust automatically for delays.
